title: Mission Platform Control Plane v1 (lifecycle/config/command/health)
description: Separate from the data plane (ADR-K002 amendment: control and data are two contracts, each its own SemVer).

cmd.description: Must be in the platform's command allowlist; non-allowlisted commands fail closed.

ticket.description: JIT AccessTicket reference when the command originates from remote support (ADR-K004).

failure_contract.on_timeout: payload marked unhealthy; restart policy from manifest.health applies
failure_contract.on_malformed: connection closed, event logged, payload restart
failure_contract.compatibility: platform 1.x accepts payload control 1.x; major mismatch = reject at load
